Fields.Name: Created
Fields.Description: when the container was made, in seconds since 1970

Fields.Name: Health
Fields.Description: healthy, unhealthy or starting; empty for a container with no health check

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: the container's whole id, sixty-four characters

Fields.Name: Image
Fields.Description: the image as the container was started with it: a name and tag, or a digest

Fields.Name: State
Fields.Description: running, exited, restarting, paused, created or dead

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Docker's own words for the state: Up 2 hours (healthy), Exited (3) 11 seconds ago

Fields.Name: SystemContainer
Fields.Description: dockhand or hawser for a container that is Dockhand itself or one of its agents, told by its image's name; nothing for any other

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: the volume's name; empty for a bind

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: bind or volume

Fields.Name: IpAddress
Fields.Description: the container's address on the network; empty while it is not running

Fields.Name: IP
Fields.Description: the address on the host the port is published on

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: tcp or udp

Fields.Name: LinkTarget
Fields.Description: what a symlink points to

Fields.Name: Modified
Fields.Description: when it last changed, in the container's own time and to the minute: 2006-01-02T15:04:00

Fields.Name: Permissions
Fields.Description: as ls writes them, without the kind: rwxr-xr-x

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: file, directory or symlink

Fields.Name: NewerVersion
Fields.Description: a newer version tag of the image, when Dockhand is set to look for them and found one

Models.Name: GetContainersPendingUpdatesAnswerPendingUpdatesNewerVersion
Models.Description: a newer version tag of the image, when Dockhand is set to look for them and found one

Fields.Name: Bump
Fields.Description: how far a step it is from the tag in use: patch, minor or major

Fields.Name: Skipped
Fields.Description: the version tags between the one in use and the newest, the newest among them

Fields.Name: Tag
Fields.Description: the newest version tag the registry has for the image

Fields.Name: SizeRootFs
Fields.Description: what its whole filesystem takes, image included, in bytes

Fields.Name: SizeRw
Fields.Description: what the container has written over its image, in bytes

Fields.Name: BlockRead
Fields.Description: bytes read from disk since it started

Fields.Name: CpuPercent
Fields.Description: the share of the host's processors it is using, where 100 is one whole processor

Fields.Name: MemoryLimit
Fields.Description: the most memory it may hold, in bytes: the host's own when it has no limit

Fields.Name: MemoryRaw
Fields.Description: the memory it holds with the file cache counted, in bytes

Fields.Name: MemoryUsage
Fields.Description: the memory it holds, less what is only file cache, in bytes

Fields.Name: NetworkRx
Fields.Description: bytes received since it started

Fields.Name: Total
Fields.Description: how many containers were checked

Fields.Name: Error
Fields.Description: why the registry could not be asked, when it could not

Fields.Name: HasUpdate
Fields.Description: whether the registry has another image under the name than the one the container was made from

Fields.Name: IsLocalImage
Fields.Description: the image was built on the host and no registry has it

Fields.Name: NewerVersion
Fields.Description: a newer version tag of the image, when Dockhand is set to look for them and found one

Fields.Name: SystemContainer
Fields.Description: dockhand or hawser for a container that is Dockhand itself or one of its agents

Fields.Name: UpdateDisabled
Fields.Description: the container carries the label dockhand.update=false, and was not looked at
